final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), s2 AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS e, AVG(s1.a) AS a FROM s1 JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s1.telescref GROUP BY t.equipstatus), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS a FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.e AS e, s2.a AS a, s2.a - s3.a AS d FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.a > s3.a), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS a FROM s4), s6 AS (SELECT s4.e AS e, s4.a AS a, s4.d AS d, s4.a - s5.a AS d2 FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s4.a > s5.a) SELECT AVG(a), AVG(d), AVG(d2) FROM s6
